errors.text_span: 图表的纵轴代表参考数量（M）
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "参数量(M)", which translates to "Parameter quantity (M)", not "参考数量" (Reference quantity).

errors.text_span: 每个条形代表一个数据集的平均值
errors.evidence: There are four bars corresponding to four categories on the y-axis (parameter quantities), not three datasets. The title "3个数据集平均值" (Average value of 3 datasets) likely means the values shown are an average over 3 datasets, but each bar represents a parameter quantity, not a dataset.
The bars are arranged vertically (from top to bottom), not horizontally (from left to right).
The reported values are incorrect. The actual values for the four bars are all between 83% and 84%. For example, the bottom bar is at approximately 83.2% and the top bar is at approximately 83.7%.

errors.text_span: 条形按照从上到下的顺序与纵轴的参考数量（M）相对应，即M=17、19、22和25时对应的MR值
errors.evidence: The bars arranged from top to bottom correspond to the M values of 25, 22, 19, and 17 respectively, which is the reverse of the order stated in the description.
